0.q: How does it compare to FileBot or TinyMediaManager?
0.a: CineRename was built from the ground up in Rust to be lightning-fast. Unlike older Java-based tools, it can process thousands of files without UI lag. We also built features that are usually missing: native ZIP/RAR extraction, an interactive visual preview, a full 'Undo' history, and multi-quality duplicate hunting.

1.a: Yes. CineRename supports anime presets with absolute episode numbering or season/episode output, plus OVA and Specials handling. For long shows where platforms disagree on seasons, you can keep absolute numbering and still fetch localized episode titles when available.

2.q: Do I have to pay a monthly subscription?
2.a: No. While we offer a yearly license for updates, we also provide a one-time 'Lifetime' payment option. We hate subscription fatigue as much as you do.

3.q: Will my files be uploaded to the cloud?
3.a: No. CineRename processes your files locally. Network requests only go to configured metadata and subtitle providers, and they contain titles, IDs, language choices, or the OpenSubtitles file fingerprint — never the video file itself.

4.q: Can it help find subtitles matching my release?
4.a: CineRename gives you the best possible match without promising magic. It uses the OpenSubtitles file fingerprint first, then falls back to title and metadata IDs. You can preview the subtitle before downloading it, and timing tools are available if a release still needs an offset or drift adjustment.

5.q: Why use CineRename instead of Sonarr/Radarr?
5.a: Sonarr and Radarr are powerful for full automation, but they require significant setup with indexers and download clients. CineRename is a lightweight, standalone tool for cleaning an existing messy drive or quickly organizing files without running a 24/7 server.

6.q: Does it run on my Headless NAS (Synology, Unraid)?
6.a: Yes. CineRename has a lightweight headless CLI, WebUI/TUI modes and Docker packaging. On servers, use the scheduler, cron, or download-client hooks; desktop Watch Folders remain available in the GUI app.

7.q: What happens if I make a mistake and rename thousands of files poorly?
7.a: Don't panic! CineRename tracks every operation in its History module. With a single click, you can undo a massive batch rename, and all your files will be restored to their original names and locations.

8.q: How will I receive my Pro license?
8.a: After purchase, you will immediately receive a license key by email. Simply enter it into the application to unlock the Pro version.

9.a: Yes. CineRename is a neutral file management tool. We do not host, provide, sell, or distribute movies, TV shows, anime, or other copyrighted media. The software only helps users organize files they already have the legal right to use.
